title: Engineering Notetaker
subtitle: Turns the team's working sessions into typed notes.
lede: Turns the team's working sessions into typed notes. Each note carries a title, a narrative and facts, a type such as decision, bug fix or discovery, and concept tags such as gotcha or trade-off, and is searchable from then on. People can also record a note by hand, import notes in batches, and take notes in 28 languages or in a special mode for email investigations.
who: An engineering team that keeps losing what it learned between sessions
author: Corey James
